claims.claim: promptarena validate and promptarena export use packc/compiler
compiler.Check stages pack_id, load, compile, skills, workflow, compositions, agents, governance, pack, pack_schema; early stages stop, later collect all
arena config, prompt configs and tool files are schema-validated on load; arena config requires providers and defaults
prompt config requires task_type, version, description, system_template; task_type pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$
variable name pattern ^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$, metadata.language ^[a-z]{2}$, tool name pattern
pack id pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$; invalid --id rejected before compile with [pack_id] error
default id from current directory name via SanitizePackID; non-letter start gets pack- prefix

skill checks: missing dir, path outside, SKILL.md parse, duplicate names, inline fields, workflow state skills path errors; allowed-tools warning; relative to config dir (compile) or pack dir (validate)
workflow errors/warnings: version 1|2, entry, prompt_task, targets, enums, composition, PascalCase, cycles, terminal, v2 dead-end, agent loops
agents errors: no members, entry not member, member not prompt; MIME/tag warnings block in packc validate
packc compile checks compositions; packc validate does not
pack structure checks id, semver version, prompts, template_engine, system_template, prompt version, variables-declared, compilation; all blocking in packc
schema failure prints '✗ Pack failed schema validation:' with path per line; schema-load failure: compile errors, validate warns and continues
packc validate runs schema first; compile runs schema last
validation uses the embedded PromptPack schema by default; PROMPTKIT_SCHEMA_SOURCE local/remote/path overrides
embedded PromptPack schema is version 1.9.0 (identical to promptpack-spec schema)
compile prints warnings as '⚠ [stage] message' and fails with 'Compilation failed:'
templates are not parsed; only check is variables declared when template contains {{
